transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um… I guess I’ve just been really slowed down lately. At work, my hands feel like they’re moving through glue or something. Even simple stuff like sectioning hair or mixing color takes me forever now, and people are starting to notice I’m not as quick as I used to be.
Have you also been feeling slowed down in your body, like it’s hard to get moving or speak?

Yeah… mostly in my body, I guess. Like at work my hands just feel slow, like they’re stuck or something. Sectioning hair or mixing color takes me way longer than it should, and… people have started noticing.
Have you ever had a period where you felt unusually energized or high?
I don’t think so… not really. I mean, I’ve had days where I’m okay, but not like unusually high or anything.
Have you been feeling depressed most of the day?
Yeah… most days. I wake up and it’s just this heavy, flat feeling, like… sadness sitting in my chest. It feels hard to see the point in trying to do anything with my life.
Have you been hearing voices when no one is there?
Sometimes… yeah. Like at the salon, when I’m sweeping or rinsing bowls, I’ll hear a woman near the shampoo stations saying I’m ruining everything. But then no one’s there, or no one’s close enough.
Do you hear that woman’s voice only when you’re feeling depressed?

No… not only then. Before I got this depressed, there were a few weeks where I was still going to work and doing things mostly normally, but I was already hearing her. And I was… pretty sure someone at the salon was messing with my schedule.
Have you lost interest in being around other people?

Yeah… I guess I have. I used to talk with clients more, help the newer girls at the salon, go hiking with friends sometimes. Lately I mostly just keep my head down and avoid people. I don’t really have that spark in me.
Have other people told you that your speech or thoughts seem jumbled or hard to follow?
I… don’t know. Maybe people say I’m quiet or distracted, but I haven’t really been told my thoughts are jumbled. At least not like that.
Have you believed that someone at the salon was trying to harm or sabotage you?

I don’t know about harm exactly… but sabotage, yeah. I’m pretty sure someone’s been watching my bookings and messing with my hours on purpose. Like the slow days happen right after I talk about needing to save money. It sounds weird, but it feels too specific.
Was there ever a time when you were hearing the woman’s voice or felt sure someone was sabotaging you for at least two weeks while you were not feeling depressed at all?

Yeah… I think so. Before the depression got really bad, there were a few weeks where I was still getting up, going to work, acting more normal, I guess. But I was already hearing her voice sometimes, and I felt pretty sure someone at the salon was messing with my schedule.
For about six months or more, have you been hearing that woman’s voice or feeling that someone at the salon was sabotaging you?
Yeah… it’s been more than six months. I guess around a year and a few months… maybe like a year and four months. The voice and the thing with my bookings.
